sentences.text: Two new preamble notes were added stating that Methylisothiazolinone (entry 57) and the Methylchloroisothiazolinone/Methylisothiazolinone mixture (entry 39) are mutually exclusive and cannot both be used in the same product.

act.display_name: Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 30 November 2009 on cosmetic products (recast) (Text with EEA relevance)

sentences.text: Entry 39 was rewritten so that the substance identification column now names the ingredient as Methylchloroisothiazolinone (and) Methylisothiazolinone rather than describing it only as a mixture of the two chemical names with magnesium chloride and magnesium nitrate, and the maximum concentration condition is now restricted to rinse-off products with the same 0,0015% ratio limit, whereas before no such rinse-off restriction was stated.
